name: Bayes Lab
desc: A rare-disease test and a biased coin: watch Bayes' rule turn a scary positive into a modest probability, and belief tighten flip by flip.
controls: Prevalence, sensitivity, false-positive rate and repeat-test sliders; true bias and prior strength; flip 1, 10 or 100 times; Space flips, H flips ten, R resets the coin
creator: Original build (Dragon Gaming Assets)
